remarks: Bright & Inviting 1-Bedroom Condo in Norwalk, CT   Welcome home to this sun-filled 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo offering comfort, convenience, and a fantastic location in the heart of Norwalk! Step inside to discover an open floorplan with a spacious living and dining area, filled with abundant natural light streaming through large windows - perfect for relaxing or entertaining creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere.  The kitchen is well-maintained and functional, with plenty of cabinet space and all essential appliances. The spacious bedroom provides a peaceful retreat with ample closet storage, while the full bath features a clean, neutral design.  Enjoy your morning coffee on the private balcony or relax with views of the beautifully kept grounds. Community amenities include a pool, clubhouse, and large open courtyard - everything you need for easy, low-maintenance living.  Located just minutes from shopping, restaurants, beaches, and major highways, this condo offers the perfect balance of tranquility and accessibility.
